en_title: The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel Name, Logo, Officially Revealed as Bethesda Marks 40th Anniversary
cn_title: 贝塞斯达庆祝40周年之际，《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》名称与标志正式公布
opus_summary: 贝塞斯达游戏工作室正式公布《上古卷轴6》的副标题Sentinel及游戏标志，陶德·霍华德在贝塞斯达庆祝40周年的视频致辞中带来了这一消息。游戏于2018年首次公布，目前尚不确定是否会登陆PlayStation。

paragraphs.en: Bethesda Game Studios has officially announced the subtitle for The Elder Scrolls 6. The long-awaited follow-up to Skyrim will be called Sentinel, making its official title The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel. A logo has also been revealed. Both come as part of a video message from longtime franchise director Todd Howard as Bethesda celebrates its 40th anniversary.
paragraphs.cn: 贝塞斯达Game Studios正式公布了《上古卷轴6》的副标题。这款备受期待的《Skyrim》续作将以Sentinel为副标题，正式名称为《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》。游戏的标志也已公布。这两项内容都出现在该系列长期以来的总监陶德·霍华德发布的一段视频致辞中，贝塞斯达正在庆祝成立40周年。

paragraphs.en: The confirmation follows a report from last week that has proven to be quite correct. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma got a demo of The Elder Scrolls VI earlier this summer, and teased the subtitle in her post by replacing the name we now know to be Sentinel with eight asterisks. Turns out those asterisks were very specific then, as Sentinel is of course eight letters.
paragraphs.cn: 这一消息证实了上周的一篇报道，该报道被证明相当准确。今年夏天早些时候，XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma体验了《上古卷轴6》的演示版，并在她的帖子中暗示了副标题，用八个星号代替了我们现在知道是Sentinel的名称。事实证明，那些星号当时确实有特定含义，毕竟Sentinel正好有八个字母。

paragraphs.en: Sentinel is a city within the province of Hammerfell on the continent of Tamriel, where The Elder Scrolls is set. It sits on the northwest coast, nestled beside Iliac Bay. Hammerfell, meanwhile, is located due west of Cyrodiil, where Oblivion took place, and southwest of Skyrim (speaking of which, Bethesda notes that The Elder Scrolls 5 is "still Bethesda Game Studios’ most played game" – and we clarified with Bethesda that this is referring to total lifetime players). Its northern border is shared with the province of High Rock, and its western edge meets the Abacean Sea
paragraphs.cn: Sentinel是Tamriel大陆上Hammerfell省的一座城市，《The Elder Scrolls》系列便以Tamriel为背景。它坐落在西北海岸，紧邻Iliac Bay。Hammerfell则位于《Oblivion》故事发生地Cyrodiil的正西方，以及Skyrim的西南方（说到这里，贝塞斯达指出，《The Elder Scrolls 5》「仍是贝塞斯达Game Studios玩家人数最多的游戏」——我们向贝塞斯达确认过，这指的是游戏推出以来的累计玩家人数）。Hammerfell北部与High Rock省接壤，西部濒临Abacean Sea。

paragraphs.en: It's been a long wait for The Elder Scrolls 6, as it was first announced way back in 2018 , and fans have waited for more information on it ever since. Today's subtitle and logo reveal are the first real bits of news on it in quite some time, though we likely have at least a couple more years to wait before playing it. On Xbox and PC, that is. With Sharma's renewed focus on console exclusives , will The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel even see the light of day on a PlayStation console? That remains to be seen, but it's the biggest card Microsoft has to play in order to get more people back into its ecosystem.
paragraphs.cn: 《上古卷轴6》让人们等待了很久：它早在2018年就首次公布，粉丝们从那以后一直在等待更多消息。今天公布的副标题和标志是相当长一段时间以来关于这款游戏的首批实质性消息，不过我们可能还要至少再等几年才能玩到它。也就是在XBOX和PC上玩到它。随着Sharma重新将重点放在主机独占游戏上，《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》究竟会不会登陆PlayStation主机？这还有待观察，但它是微软为吸引更多人回到其生态系统而能打出的最大一张牌。

paragraphs.en: For now, though, at least we've got the Sentinel name, and we'll have to cross our fingers that we get a proper reveal at next year's Xbox Showcase in June.
paragraphs.cn: 不过目前，至少我们已经知道了Sentinel这个名字，接下来只能祈祷它能在明年6月的XBOX Showcase上正式亮相。

paragraphs.en: Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .
paragraphs.cn: Ryan McCaffrey是IGN预览内容执行编辑、IGN每周XBOX节目《Podcast Unlocked》的主持人，也是《Next-Gen Console Watch》的联合主持人。他是North Jersey人，所以那叫「Taylor ham」，而不是「pork roll」。可以通过X上的@DMC_Ryan和他争论这个问题。
